//: Reviewed, intentional differences from compat/baseline.json that must not fail `npm run check:compat`. Friction on purpose: every entry needs an id (copy it from the failure output), a reason a reviewer can check, and the version that introduces it. Prefer deprecating and keeping the old API; only genuinely compatible-in-practice changes or deliberate (major) breaks belong here. Entries that stop matching anything are reported so they get removed (they become obsolete once the baseline is regenerated at release time).

allowed.reason: Issue #94: Modal `size` widened from "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "fullscreen" to ResponsiveValue<ModalSize> (ModalSize adds "2xl"), the same ResponsiveValue pattern Button/Accordion/TabNavigation use. Every value that compiled before still compiles (compat/consumer.fixture.tsx passes `size="md"`) and renders the identical class list (pinned in Modal.test.tsx). The real break: code that reads the type back, e.g. `Record<NonNullable<ModalProps['size']>, X>` or forwarding a `ModalProps['size']` value into the old string union, no longer compiles; the fix is the new `ModalSize` export (`Record<ModalSize, X>`).
